summary.name: Min
summary.one_liner: Min is a fast, minimal open-source web browser that blocks ads and trackers and offers tab grouping, full-text history search, and tags for bookmarks.
use_cases: organizing many open tabs into tasks
summary.what_it_does: Min is a web browser whose tabs take up less space, and pages you have not viewed in a while fade out. Focus Mode hides other tabs to reduce distraction. Tasks group and organize tabs, with keyboard shortcuts for switching between them and automatic collapsing of unused tasks. It can search the full text of pages you have visited, stored on your device, and supports tags for bookmarks, suggesting similar pages based on them. It blocks most ads and trackers automatically and states it does not share browsing history. The project is open source on GitHub and written entirely in JavaScript.
notable: Full-text search of visited pages stored on device
Tasks feature groups tabs with auto-collapse
Written entirely in JavaScript and open source on GitHub
caveats: Platform support beyond macOS is not stated on the page text
Page text does not name a specific license
